description: City applies for federal fleet electrification funding.
If successful, $774,100 loan for vehicle replacement.
Also, $186,100 grant, $156,400 loan for EV adoption.
Reallocates $85,000 from solar to environmental reserve.

chips.text: Taxpayers, through city loans and reallocation of reserve funds.
Electrifying the municipal fleet will reduce emissions and improve air quality.

description: Multi-unit garbage service will become utility-funded.
